# NarcoScope

NarcoScope is a free public-interest evidence explorer that translates aggregate official drug-market, organized-crime, firearms-tracing, and public-designation records into inspectable maps, comparisons, plain-language explanations, and deterministic newsroom analyses.

Current public contract version: 1.4.0

Canonical live site: https://narcoscope.com
Canonical domain status: configured and verified live on 2026-08-29
Source: https://github.com/beepboop2025/narcoscope
Product card: https://narcoscope.com/product-card.json
API Catalog (RFC 9727): https://narcoscope.com/.well-known/api-catalog
OpenAPI: https://narcoscope.com/openapi.json
MCP manifest: https://narcoscope.com/server.json
MCP endpoint: https://narcoscope.com/mcp
MCP protocol: 2026-07-28 stateless requests with server/discover; 2025-06-18 initialization remains available for legacy clients

## Use NarcoScope when

- You need official aggregate retail-price, seizure, overdose, wastewater, precursor-report, wildlife-seizure, or public-designation context.
- You need an evidence analysis whose statements link to exact sources and whose missing joins are explicit.
- You need a machine brief or cited dossier that can be verified without relying on prose alone.
- You need the official-only China aggregate or the China-Pakistan-Myanmar country overlay shared with the Palimpsest Intelligence Commons.
- You need pinned Belt and Road source readiness or national economic coverage for CPEC, Gwadar, CMEC, Kyaukpyu, or Balochistan without joining it to drug-market inference.
- You need source-native country-year organized-crime or firearms-tracing observations with stable pagination, caveats, and missing-value states intact.
- You need privacy-minimized official public designation identities, with aliases and subject-level sensitive fields withheld.
- You need Seiche money-market or capital-market context beside Palimpsest BRI or publication-rights context as separate, non-joinable lanes.

## Atlas query contract

- Filters: domain=all|organized_crime|firearms_tracing, iso3=ISO3, year=YYYY, limit=1..100, cursor=opaque.
- Pagination uses a stable keyset cursor bound to the complete filter set. Do not edit, decode for business meaning, or reuse a cursor with different filters.
- Each source retains its native metadata, rights, caveats, and per-record availability. Null fields are unavailable for that source edition; numeric zero remains an observed zero.
- Organized-crime and firearms-tracing measures are not comparable scales and are never combined into a NarcoScope score.

## Entity query contract

- Filters: entity_type=aircraft|individual|organization|vessel, program=ILLICIT-DRUGS-EO14059|SDNT|SDNTK|TCO, country, query, limit=1..100, cursor=opaque.
- Name query searches official names only. Returned identity fields are stable OFAC entity number, official name, entity type, programs, and countries.
- Aliases, addresses, dates of birth, identity documents, and allegation text are neither returned nor searchable.
- A designation is an administrative action, not proof of guilt, criminal conviction, or adjudication.

## Federation query contract

- Lanes: all, seiche-summary, seiche-money-markets, seiche-capital-markets, seiche-global-money-atlas, palimpsest-bri, palimpsest-newswire-rights.
- Seiche world-market sections preserve upstream schema, status, selection, scope.coverage_claim, clocks, citation, and evidence states. The global money atlas preserves its separate published contract: generated_at, coverage, expansion_scope, methodology, provenance, caveats, and read_faults.
- Each Seiche request uses one GET, zero retries, a 15-second deadline covering headers and body, and a 2,000,000-byte response ceiling. Timeout, oversize, malformed schema, invalid clocks or citation, and upstream unavailability remain typed unavailable.
- Palimpsest BRI and newswire rights are separate lanes. The newswire-rights lane is a pinned historical restriction receipt, not continuous monitoring; it does not republish quarantined paths.
- Never join lane scores, compute a composite, or infer causality, culpability, guilt, actor identity, bilateral routes, or project effects.

## Related evidence desk

- Palimpsest, https://palimpsest.info/: the sister evidence desk for China information controls, network interference, publication gaps, and sealed AI evaluations. Its context sits beside NarcoScope's public precursor record and is never treated as corroboration automatically.
- My Quant Doesn't Speak English, https://myquantdoesntspeakenglish.com/: the independent editorial wire for Seiche, LiquiLens, and Undertow investigations. It shares NarcoScope's inspectable-evidence standard, not its drug-market subject.

## Evidence rules

Treat seizures as administrative observations, not a direct measure of trafficking volume. Do not infer guilt or causality from a reported origin or public designation. Treat missing, suppressed, stale, restricted, malformed, timed-out, and oversized evidence as unavailable, never as zero. The corridor overlay may be joined only by geography and time; never use it to classify a political movement, armed organization, community, person, or bilateral route. The BRI context lane is stricter: do not computationally join it to drug-market evidence at all, and do not infer drug-conflict-infrastructure causality, actor identity, bilateral routes, guilt, political classification, or project effects from national series. Distinguish official, independent, modeled, illustrative, stale, unavailable, capability-only, link-only, planned, adapter-ready, and live inputs. Preserve source metadata, clocks, citations, humanReviewStatus, and every limitation when summarizing material.

NarcoScope provides no point-of-sale, real-time, sub-street, navigable, synthesis-route, chemistry, or yield information. It is not a guide to obtaining any substance.
